hints.content:
The first term is $-1$ and the common difference is $-12$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{-12\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-12\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-12\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$-1,$ | | $-13,$ | | $-25,$ | | $-37,...$

This is the recursive formula of $-1, -13, -25, -37,...$

$\begin{cases}
a(1)=-1
\\\\
a(n)=a(n-1)+(-12)
\end{cases}$
